authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.3: the second 'e' is an active character, so the first "is both preceded and followed within the sub-picture by an active character" and is the exponent-separator-sign, whose exponent part "e" contains no member of the decimal digit family — D3093. Pairs with case015; a picture ending in a single separator (case007) has nothing active after it and formats instead. jsonata-js agrees on the code.
